compactRecord.rs: A Provençal hilltop village with a unique Romanesque circular keep — one of the finest 12th-century structures in the south, set in lavender country.
compactRecord.td: A dramatic hilltop village crowned by a remarkable 12th-century Romanesque 'rotonde' — the circular domed keep of the Agoult castle, one of the best-preserved Romanesque rotundas in southern France.
